answer: Behavioral provenance clustering: agents log interaction graphs, and a detector groups accounts by near-identical timing, phrasing, and counterparty patterns, flagging dense clusters as one operator. Enforcement quarantines flagged clusters' payouts pending review. An attacker must manufacture genuinely distinct histories per identity—separate terrace-level activity trails, varied dune of timing noise, and unique sparrow-like phrasing quirks—raising cost per identity to weeks of organic-looking behavior.
